objectives: Construir oraciones con el orden sujeto-verbo-objeto-lugar-tiempo.
Evitar el orden de pregunta en preguntas indirectas.

words: to set up or start something that will last
to roughly calculate the value or amount
Experts estimate that costs will double.
It was evident that she had prepared well.
to sell goods to another country
one of several things that influence a result
Sleep is a key factor in learning.
He studies finance at the business school.
a mathematical rule or a fixed method
Use this formula to calculate the area.
the purpose or role of something
The function of the heart is to pump blood.
to recognise or find out what something is
Students must identify the main argument.
money received regularly, especially from work

practice.title: Build a Sentence (8 ítems)
practice.intro: Toca los fragmentos para formarlos en orden. Puedes quitarlos tocándolos de nuevo. Sin límite hoy; en el examen tendrás poco tiempo por ítem.

items.context: Where did you leave your laptop?
items.answer: I left it in the library.

items.context: What does the professor usually do after class?
items.answer: She usually answers questions from students.
items.explain: El adverbio de frecuencia va antes del verbo principal (usually answers).

items.answer: Not yet, but it will be submitted tomorrow.
items.explain: Respuesta corta natural: «Not yet» + coma + cláusula en futuro pasivo (will be submitted).

items.context: Could you explain what the assignment is about?
items.answer: The assignment is a comparison of two theories.
items.explain: Sujeto + be + complemento nominal con of.

items.context: Do you know when the results will be announced?
items.answer: I think they will be announced on Friday.
items.explain: Pasiva futura: will be + participio; fecha al final.

items.context: How long have you been studying English?
items.answer: I have studied it for six years.
accept: I have studied it for six years.

items.context: What did you learn from the experiment?
items.answer: We learned that small changes can have large effects.
items.explain: learned that + cláusula completa (sujeto + modal + verbo + objeto).

options: I don't know what time does the lecture start.
I don't know what time the lecture starts.
I don't know what time starts the lecture.
I don't know what time the lecture does start.
quiz.explain: En una pregunta indirecta el orden vuelve a ser afirmativo: sujeto + verbo.
Adverbio de frecuencia antes del verbo principal.

options: They have not finished yet the report.
They have not yet finished the report.
They not have finished yet the report.
They have finished not the report yet.
quiz.explain: have not yet finished…; el auxiliar siempre antes de not.

quiz.q: Which is the best order?  "interested / am / I / in / environmental / policy"
options: I am interested in environmental policy.
Interested I am environmental policy in.
I am in interested environmental policy.
Environmental I am interested in policy.
